description.en: Control labscript-suite experiments from DeepSeek Harness: runmanager panel globals and scans, submit and wait, YAML fixed-operation protocols with postprocess write-back, panel snapshots and selective restore, an event log, a hardware-free mock backend, a read-only doctor and a settings page. Uses only the stock runmanager remote interface and shot HDF5; no BLACS/lyse patches required.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里控制 labscript-suite 实验：runmanager 面板 globals 与扫描、提交与等待、带后处理写回和面板恢复的 YAML 固定操作协议、写前快照与选择性恢复、事件日志、无硬件模拟后端、只读诊断工具和插件页配置。只用 stock runmanager remote 与 shot HDF5，不需要改 BLACS/lyse。
